# `google_analytics` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/google-analytics.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Module id | `google_analytics` |
| Name | Google Analytics |
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Ships from | `@endora-commerce/mod-google-analytics` |
| Licence tier | — |

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `google_analytics.module_enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |

| `audit_logs` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
